chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan, from Ibn Miskan, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about the siblings from the mother, and he said: 'For the siblings is their prescribed share, one-third, along with the grandfather.'

key_terms.الْإِخْوَةِ مِنَ الْأُمِّ: Uterine siblings (siblings sharing only the mother)
key_terms.الْجَدِّ: The grandfather (specifically paternal in this context)

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of uterine siblings when inheriting with the paternal grandfather?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishing that uterine siblings (*ikhwat min al-umm*) receive one-third of the estate when inheriting alongside the paternal grandfather. This ruling highlights the specific Shia jurisprudential position where the grandfather does not exclude uterine siblings, distinguishing it from other schools where the grandfather may take the residual share or exclude them entirely. The hadith clarifies the fixed portion (*fard*) for these siblings in the presence of this specific ascendant.
